name: Billboard Project (DDMAL)
desc: chords, structure, instrumentation, and timing annotations of Billboard chart hits.

name: EWLD (Enhanced Wikifonia Leadsheet Dataset)
desc: more than 5,000 leadsheets and rich metadata based on the crowd-sourced Wikifonia corpus, which is no longer online.

name: Isophonics
desc: data (and software) from the [Centre for Digital Music (‘C4DM’)](https://c4dm.eecs.qmul.ac.uk/) across a range of repertoires and parameters (structure, key, chord, beats).

name: Jazz Audio-Aligned Harmony (JAAH) Dataset
desc: 113 tracks selected from Smithsonian jazz collections. See also [MTG's Open Source Technologies](https://mtg.github.io/JAAH/)

name: Peachnote
desc: Ngrams of melodies and chord progressions from IMSLP c.2011.

name: RWC Music Database
access_note: Free for research use but permission must be requested.

name: Temperley / Kostka-Payne chords
desc: by Temperley, after the textbook by Kostka and Payne. Direct download [here](https://davidtemperley.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/kp-corpus-files.zip)

name: YCAC Dataset
desc: .csv datasets of pitch 'slices' from the [Classical Archives](https://www.classicalarchives.com/) MIDI corpus
